RJ-003-FALLBACK-ARM.notes: fires if RJ-002 finds that rich historical features cannot be reconstructed as-of without leakage. Units: define the reconstructible input set; fit the arm; validate its interval coverage; register the identity. A worse honest arm beats an indefinite outage — but it must be a REGISTERED identity with its own coverage validation, never the primary arm with wider error bars.
